tickets.subject: Cannot sign in to my account
tickets.body: My password is accepted on the login page, but I am redirected back to the sign-in screen and cannot access the workspace. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: MFA verification code is not arriving
tickets.body: I requested several verification codes, but none of them arrived by email, so I cannot complete the login process. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: How can I invite a new user?
tickets.body: I need instructions for inviting a new colleague and assigning the correct workspace access. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Permission denied for shared report
tickets.body: The report was shared with me, but opening it displays a permission denied message. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Charged twice for the same subscription
tickets.body: Two identical subscription charges appear on our card statement for the current billing period. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Need a copy of last month's invoice
tickets.body: Could you provide the invoice for the previous billing period for our accounting team? This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Question about plan pricing
tickets.body: I would like to understand the difference between the current plan and the next subscription tier. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Unexpected automatic renewal
tickets.body: Our subscription renewed even though we intended to cancel it, and I would like the charge reviewed. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: API returns 401 with a valid key
tickets.body: Requests to the API started returning HTTP 401 even though the API key is active and has not changed. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Production webhooks are not delivered
tickets.body: No production webhook events have been delivered for the last hour, blocking our order-processing integration. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Question about API pagination
tickets.body: Please explain how to request the next page when the API response contains a continuation cursor. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: API requests receive rate-limit errors
tickets.body: Our normal request volume now receives HTTP 429 responses even though usage is below the documented limit. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Save button does not update the record
tickets.body: Clicking Save closes the form, but the edited values are missing when the record is opened again. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: CSV export crashes for every user
tickets.body: The export action fails with an error for all users in our workspace, so the team cannot download required data. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Typo in the settings page
tickets.body: The account settings page contains a spelling mistake in the notification description. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Changes disappear after page refresh
tickets.body: Newly entered values appear to save successfully but disappear immediately after refreshing the page. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Request for dark mode
tickets.body: It would be helpful to have a dark theme for users who work in the application at night. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Request for bulk record export
tickets.body: Please consider adding an option to export multiple selected records in a single operation. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Request for additional SSO provider
tickets.body: We would like native support for another SAML identity provider for our enterprise rollout. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Dashboard loads very slowly
tickets.body: The dashboard now takes around twenty seconds to open, while other parts of the application load normally. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Production requests time out
tickets.body: All requests in our production integration are timing out and the business workflow is currently blocked. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Large report takes several minutes
tickets.body: Generating the monthly report takes more than five minutes and significantly delays the team. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Update company address
tickets.body: Please tell me where an administrator can update the company address shown in the account profile. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Change notification preferences
tickets.body: I would like to disable weekly summary emails while keeping security notifications enabled. This concerns our main workspace.

tickets.subject: Thank you for resolving the issue
tickets.body: The previous problem is resolved and everything works correctly now. Thank you for the quick assistance. This concerns our main workspace.
